main_text.l: enim uila cum Anglica & Scotica, vel cum Hispanica, cognatione iungitur: etsi Hibernia pluribus annis Regibus Angliae subdita est, & a Scotia haud multum distat: uti nec ab Hispania; quae curis faventibus tridui navali cursu, ab occasu poteft attingi. Barbaram igitur & inconditam linguam no, infcite dixeris: ut vel ex his infra scriptis versibus Psalmi cIII. luculenter appa et.
Anaim chlao'n,chcmh falfa,molfa tighearna ar faorthe:a uile bhriogh chorpardhe,molvigh fos a ainm naomhtha.
Mol a anuim jongla in fonan tighearna fuaire folus:mol a uile thiodhluice,nar dearmuid gan a moladh, &c.
1. My foule giue laud unto the Lord,my spirit shall do the same:And all the secretes of my hartpraise ye his holy name.
2. Giue thankes to God for all his gifts, shew
